liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Reviewer praises the first set's strength through to the closing Let It Grow into Deal [19]
- **I Will Take You Home** (1 review): Reviewer sees this new Weir song as a fitting present for his birthday show [20]
- **Never Trust A Woman** (1 review): Reviewer notes Bobby didn't sing the 'across the Rio Grande' line [26]
- Reviewer still gets chills from the opening Dark Star licks [17]
- Reviewer describes the second set's jamming as near-continuous, with band sounding like they'd unwrapped new MIDI equipment [21]
- Uploader notes the second Dark Star return after I Need A Miracle has only the second verse [1]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd89-10-16 s1t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd89-10-16 s1t02 Picasso Moon**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd89-10-16 s1t03 Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodeloo**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd89-10-16 s1t04 Feel Like A Stranger**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd89-10-16 s1t05 Never Trust A Woman**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd89-10-16 s1t06 Built To Last**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd89-10-16 s1t07 Stuck Inside Of Mobile With The Memphis Blues Again**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd89-10-16 s1t08 Let It Grow**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-10-16.142543.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk4.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 150 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd89-10-16.dsbd.barrick.446.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 145 min; rated 4.38/5 by 29 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the soundboard has great sound [27]
- **gd1989-10-16.mtx.hansokolow.96899.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 149 min; rated 3.33/5 by 6 [5]. Said about its sound: Set one sounds quite good; the second set sounds fantastic [5]
- **gd1989-10-16.165022.mtx.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 147 min [7]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says state troopers let them through when they shouldn't have, and a full moon hung over the night [17]
- Reviewer feels the band seem a little tired after space in the second set [19]
- Reviewer says Adam Katz was killed on 10-14-89, two days earlier, beaten by Meadowlands security, with no convictions made [22]
- Reviewer says it was Bobby's birthday show; he wore a pink polo shirt and new Nikes, a gift from his mom [26]
- Reviewer prefers this show to 10/09/89 because the first set is so tight and well jammed [19]
- Reviewer notes no second-set song predates 1971, except I Need A Miracle (mid-1970s) and I Will Take You Home (1989) [20]
- Reviewer calls this possibly the most essential show of Fall '89 [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-10-16.142543.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk4.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Ted Mattes' Master (FOB)Audience Dat; Schoeps CMC4/MK4 mics @ 110 degrees, ORTF, Schoeps t-bar, hand held, chin high > Monster… [1]. Also: Taped with Schoeps microphones, CMC4 capsules, and the show was officially released as Nightfall of Diamonds [1]
- **gd89-10-16.dsbd.barrick.446.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Dave Barrick; source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Reviewer once had a worn, warped cassette of the second set and repaired it by moving the tape into other shells; Reviewer says the show was officially released as Nightfall of Diamonds; Commenter notes the show has been officially released as Nightfall of Diamonds [21][26][28]
- **gd1989-10-16.mtx.hansokolow.96899.flac16**: source: matrix of DSBD: shnid=446 and AUD: shnid=32131 (Set 1) and DAUD: shnid=34658 (Set 2) by hansokolow using ProTools [5]. Also: Matrix of an analog audience tape slowed song by song to match the soundboard [5]
- **gd1989-10-16.165022.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (44/16) [7]. Also: Mix made by an archive.org user, converted to FLAC in 2023; officially released as Nightfall of Diamonds [7]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by sageandspirit75.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead Nightfall Of Diamonds: Monday, October 16, 1989 Meadowlands Arena, East Rutherford, NJ](https://sageandspirit75.blogspot.com/2013/11/this-complete-show-recorded-on-10-16-89.html) [32]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Meadowlands Arena - October 16, 1989](https://www.dead.net/show/october-16-1989) [33]
